event.description: Use SiLU with one new FF-output scalar union
event.proposal: Family: feed-forward width. Current retained frontier is 1,672 parameters at 99.010000%, a +0.010000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 18 prior attempts in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0022 at 3,040 parameters/99.85%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0126, whose least-salient hidden-unit deletion scored 0.01% at 1,644 parameters. In the adjacent tying evidence, attempt-0087's next GELU output union (143,100) failed at 1,694, while current checkpoint pair (82,85) is the least-difference untested output union (1.454e-4). Hypothesis: SiLU's smooth multiplicative gate can tolerate this one-scalar synthesis compression better than GELU while preserving width 16. Replace GELU by SiLU and union only output coordinates 82/85, yielding 1,671 parameters. This is more informative than ReLU because SiLU is the closest smooth, nonmonotonicity-reduced alternative and changes activation geometry minimally.
